closeout_operational_failures.false_witness: One combined read-only Git, Python, Node, npm, and Codex version probe would finish inside its bounded reporting window.
closeout_operational_failures.observed: The wrapper returned no attributable payload at the reporting boundary and no dedicated version-probe process remained afterward.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the wrapper at zero credit, split Git, Python, Node, and npm into literal scalar probes, and leave the Codex CLI version explicitly unverified rather than relaunching or updating it.

closeout_operational_failures.false_witness: A read-only closeout inspection addressed the terminal checklist under the directory where it was generated.
closeout_operational_failures.observed: The inspection requested closeout/terminal-checklist.json, while the final staged-review ledger correctly placed the generated document at final/terminal-checklist.json.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the failed path assumption at zero credit and read only the exact path declared by the staged-review expected-path ledger; no repository state or validation result is inferred from the failed read.

closeout_operational_failures.false_witness: The first additive patch for CM6806-CL-N002 matched the exact current builder context.
closeout_operational_failures.observed: The patch verifier rejected a stale expected wording fragment before changing any file.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the rejected patch at zero credit, read the bounded current context, and apply the narrow additive change against exact lines.

closeout_operational_failures.false_witness: The generated integrated-overview prose already reflected the expanded closeout-failure ledger.
closeout_operational_failures.observed: A bounded source review found one stale sentence that still described only the original version-probe failure after two additional retained closeout failures were added.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the stale prose assertion at zero credit, make the sentence enumerate all four closeout failures, and regenerate every dependent closeout digest before commit.

closeout_operational_failures.false_witness: The closeout builder could safely regenerate dependent artifacts while corrected builder and test bytes were still unstaged against an already populated final index.
closeout_operational_failures.observed: The builder's tracked-unstaged safety rail rejected the run before generation.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the refused run at zero credit, unstage only the exact 25-path declared final set without changing working-tree bytes, and regenerate from the pre-stage lifecycle state.

closeout_operational_failures.false_witness: The combined shell wrapper would stop before tests if the immediately preceding builder command failed.
closeout_operational_failures.observed: PowerShell continued after the builder refusal, so the suite ran against stale generated artifacts and returned 15 passing and 3 failing tests; the aggregate earns zero success credit.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the 15/18 aggregate at zero success credit, restore the correct pre-stage lifecycle order, regenerate dependent artifacts, and run the dependency-closed suite only after generation succeeds.

closeout_operational_failures.false_witness: The standalone staged content-seal probe could reuse the generic manifest entries key without first inspecting the seal schema.
closeout_operational_failures.observed: The read-only probe raised KeyError for entries because the inspected seal correctly stores its content-addressed rows under targets.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the failed schema assumption at zero credit, inspect the exact seal document and current canonical/test consumers, then replay only the declared targets key with the existing single batch reader.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell startup skill-inventory foreach expression was piped before materialization and raised EmptyPipeElement.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Materialize the bounded rows array before projection; every selected skill and required reference was then read through EOF.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The first combined four-manifest replay crossed its bounded reporting window and returned no attributable result.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Confirm no matching process remained, then split the same read-only x1, evidence, final-delta, and final-owner checks; all four passed without canonical replay.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: A read probe targeted the source x1 builder inside the new sparse worktree where that inherited path was intentionally absent.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Read the immutable source-owner file from its verified read-only worktree instead of broadening Caelen's sparse checkout.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The first term-audit foreach projection repeated the EmptyPipeElement construction fault before any result was emitted.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Materialize projection rows first and retain the malformed wrapper at zero credit.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The repeated multi-term Git search crossed its bounded output window and yielded no attributable corpus result.

startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Reject those two draft titles before freeze, replace only them with print-proof-specific approval-quorum and keyboard-plus-screen-magnification evidence questions, and rerun the exact-source audit.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: The first atomic phase-tool recorder assumed a successful pyupgrade rewrite must return exit code zero.
x2_operational_failures.observed: The installed pyupgrade command rewrote the disposable legacy fixture and returned one, so the recorder rejected the entire attempt before persisting per-tool component state.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the atomic attempt at zero aggregate credit, isolate the pyupgrade exit contract, accept one only when the disposable file changed as required, then rerun the atomic receipt because no component result survived the failed attempt.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: The first isolated pyupgrade diagnostic embedded a quoted fixture safely in a multiline command string.
x2_operational_failures.observed: Python rejected the diagnostic before execution with an unterminated string literal.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Use one literal single-quoted PowerShell argument for the isolated disposable fixture; it proved exit one plus the expected rewrite without touching repository bytes.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: A staged evidence-manifest replay using one git show process per entry would finish inside the bounded presentation window.
x2_operational_failures.observed: The 148-process wrapper crossed its reporting window and left no attributable replay receipt; process inspection then found no matching process alive.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the wrapper at zero credit and replay the same staged entries through one ordered git cat-file --batch stream with normalized-LF hashing.
